Q3 release — initial requirements summary (one-page, bullet-format). 
Key objectives: enable updated payment processing flow (new payment methods + retry logic); ensure consistent customer-facing behavior for failures/retries/receipts; improve transaction reliability and compliance (PCI/tax updates). 
Scope boundaries: In-scope — payment gateway integration, checkout UX changes, server-side reconciliation/logging, customer notifications; Out-of-scope — vendor contract negotiations, analytics fraud-model retraining, billing UI redesign.
